subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Whistleblower Programs That Work
description: A micro-lesson that makes Whistleblower Programs That Work usable.

hook.text: A compliance officer reports fraud internally. Management fires her. She calls the SEC instead.

buildup.text: Effective whistleblower programs protect reporters from retaliation and reward valuable tips.

discovery.text: The SEC whistleblower program has resulted in $6 billion in sanctions since its creation in 2011.

twist.text: Internal hotlines catch more fraud than external ones, but only if employees trust that reporting is safe.

climax.text: Whistleblowers are the most effective fraud detectors. Protecting them is the most important anti-fraud investment.

punchline.text: Protect the whistleblower. They catch what auditors miss.

quiz.question: How much in sanctions has the SEC whistleblower program generated?
